info.title: MeetMind API
info.description: REST API for MeetMind, an AI meeting intelligence app. Mobile clients authenticate at POST /api/mobile-auth/login and send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. All endpoints marked with bearerAuth require that token.

post.summary: Create a new user account (email + password)

name.description: Optional; defaults to the email local-part.

post.summary: Verify an email/password pair (does not establish a session)
post.description: Checks credentials and returns the user record on success. This does NOT create a session or token; mobile clients should use POST /api/mobile-auth/login to obtain a bearer token.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of meetings to return.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search over title, transcript and executive summary.

get.summary: Get a single meeting with action items, linked documents and notes

schema.description: Any subset of writable meeting fields.

get.summary: Get counts of the user's meetings, documents and notes

post.summary: Create a document library record for an uploaded file

delete.summary: Delete a document and its stored file

get.summary: List the current user's composer notes

patch.summary: Update a composer note's title and content

post.summary: Get a presigned URL for uploading a file to cloud storage

200.description: Presigned upload URL and the resulting storage path

post.description: Returns a streamed text/plain body containing OpenAI-style SSE chunks from the transcription model; concatenate the streamed content client-side.

audioBase64.description: Base64-encoded audio data (no data URI prefix).

post.summary: Analyze a transcript into a structured summary (Server-Sent Events)
post.description: Returns a text/event-stream. Progress events look like {"status":"processing"}; the final event is {"status":"completed","result":{...structured summary...}}. When meetingId is provided, the summary and action items are persisted to that meeting.

meetingId.description: If set, results are saved to this meeting.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of progress and the final structured summary

post.summary: Ask the AI a question grounded in meeting and document context (streaming plain text)
post.description: Returns a streamed text/plain body containing OpenAI-style SSE chunks from the chat model; concatenate the streamed content client-side.

post.summary: Extract an MP3 audio track from a stored audio/video file
post.description: Runs a server-side FFmpeg job and blocks until it finishes. Returns the URL of the extracted audio on success.
Returns a request_id to poll with /api/generate-pdf/status.

post.summary: Poll the status of an HTML-to-PDF job
post.description: Returns status PENDING/RUNNING while processing, SUCCESS with pdf_base64 when done, or FAILED with an error.

name.description: Optional; defaults to the email local-part.

user.description: The signed-in user from NextAuth's session.
